Class LineConverters

java.lang.Object
com.lab.repository.file.LineConverters
public class LineConverters extends Object
Conversions between entities and the text lines used in the data files. The methods are meant to be passed to FileRepository as method references.

    • parseFriendship

      public static Friendship parseFriendship(String line)
      Parses a friendship from a line with the format id1;id2;date. The ids are normalized so that the smaller one is always on the left.
      Parameters:
      line - the text line
      Returns:
      the parsed friendship
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the line does not have exactly 3 fields
      NumberFormatException - if an id is not a number
      DateTimeParseException - if the date is invalid
